mapper.insert: INSERT INTO generation_task (request_id, app_id, user_id, code_gen_type, execution_state, fence_token, execution_owner, heartbeat_at, execution_expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{appId}, #{userId}, #{codeGenType}, 'RUNNING', #{fenceToken}, #{executionOwner}, CASE WHEN #{executionOwner} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) END, CASE WHEN #{executionOwner} IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) END, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE generation_task SET heartbeat_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), execution_expires_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, 90, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND app_id = #{appId} AND execution_owner = #{owner} AND fence_token = #{fenceToken} AND execution_state = 'RUNNING' AND execution_expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_fence f WHERE f.app_id = #{appId} AND f.current_token = #{fenceToken})
UPDATE generation_task SET cancel_requested_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND cancel_requested_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT fence_token FROM generation_task WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT generation_task.request_id, app_id, user_id, code_gen_type, execution_state, error_code, COALESCE((SELECT a.cancel_requested_at FROM generation_arbitration a WHERE a.request_id = generation_task.request_id AND a.app_id = generation_task.app_id AND a.fence_token = generation_task.fence_token), cancel_requested_at) AS cancel_requested_at, created_at, updated_at, finished_at, query_until, fence_token, execution_owner, heartbeat_at, execution_expires_at, CASE WHEN execution_state <> 'RUNNING' THEN 'TERMINAL' WHEN execution_owner IS NULL OR heartbeat_at IS NULL OR execution_expires_at IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN' WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM generation_fence f WHERE f.app_id = generation_task.app_id AND f.current_token = generation_task.fence_token) THEN 'SUPERSEDED' WHEN execution_expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'LIVE' END AS heartbeat_state FROM generation_task WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND (query_until IS NULL OR query_until > #{now}) AND request_id = #{requestId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, request_id DESC LIMIT 1
